skills.title: Ask what something is called or what a word means
skills.can_do: Can ask what a thing is called, what a word means or how to say something, and point to what they want.

skills.title: Understand spoken numbers, prices and times
skills.can_do: Can catch numbers, prices and clock times said aloud at normal-slow speed, face to face or over a loudspeaker.

skills.title: Keep a conversation going when you don't understand
skills.can_do: Can show they did not understand and ask the other person to repeat, slow down or spell a word.

skills.title: Read public signs and notices
skills.can_do: Can understand common signs and short notices: entrance, exit, open, closed, push, pull, no smoking, break times.

skills.title: Ask and tell the time, day and date
skills.can_do: Can ask and say what time it is, on which day or date something happens, and use today, tomorrow, yesterday.

skills.title: Give your personal details when asked
skills.can_do: Can give name (and spell it), address, phone number, nationality and date of birth when asked slowly.

skills.title: Fill in a simple form
skills.can_do: Can fill in a simple paper or online form (registration, order) with personal details, dates and numbers.

skills.title: Introduce yourself and get to know someone
skills.can_do: Can say and ask name, where they are from, where they live, what they do and which languages they speak.

skills.title: Give a short self-introduction to a group
skills.can_do: Can give a short prepared introduction of themselves to a group: name, origin, home, work, likes.

skills.title: Introduce yourself in a message
skills.can_do: Can write a short message introducing themselves to someone new and ask one or two questions back.

skills.title: Greet, thank, apologise and say goodbye
skills.can_do: Can greet, ask how someone is and react, thank, apologise and take leave, choosing formal or informal address.

skills.title: Talk about your family
skills.can_do: Can say who is in their family (and pets), their names, ages and jobs, and ask about the other person's.

skills.title: Describe a family photo
skills.can_do: Can show a photo and say who is who, where they stand and what they look like.

skills.title: Visit or host friends at home
skills.can_do: As guest or host: welcome, offer and accept food and drink, hand over a gift, pay a compliment, thank and leave.

skills.title: Find each other at a meeting point by message
skills.can_do: Can text where they are, what they are wearing, or that they are running late, and understand the same.

skills.title: React to friends' posts
skills.can_do: Can react to posts with short comments and reply to comments with thanks or an apology.

skills.title: Make plans with a friend
skills.can_do: Can invite someone, accept or decline, and agree on day, time and place to meet.

skills.title: Make plans by text message
skills.can_do: Can read and write short messages proposing, accepting or declining a meeting and confirming time and place.

skills.title: Propose a short toast
skills.can_do: Can propose a very short, rehearsed toast at a meal or celebration.

skills.title: Understand a friend's voice message
skills.can_do: Can get who, what, when and where from a short, clear voice message.

skills.title: Write birthday and holiday wishes
skills.can_do: Can write short congratulations and wishes for a birthday or a holiday.

skills.title: Talk about where you live
skills.can_do: Can say and ask about the city and area they live in and describe their home and rooms simply.

skills.title: Leave a short note
skills.can_do: Can leave a note saying where they have gone and when they will be back.

skills.title: Talk about your daily routine
skills.can_do: Can say what they do on a normal day, on a workday and at the weekend, and when.

skills.title: Read an event poster or programme
skills.can_do: Can find what is on, when, where and how much on a poster, programme or leaflet.

skills.title: Talk about free time and likes
skills.can_do: Can say what they like and dislike doing, how often, and ask the other person.

skills.title: Write about your hobbies and likes
skills.can_do: Can write a short post or message about their hobbies, likes and dislikes.

skills.title: Get the topic of a news item or advert
skills.can_do: Can tell what a short news item or advert is about, helped by pictures.

skills.title: Read a short illustrated text
skills.can_do: Can follow a short illustrated story or news snippet written in very simple language.

skills.title: Follow a guided tour
skills.can_do: Can follow very simple information on a guided tour: what a building is, how old, who lived there.

skills.title: Understand station announcements
skills.can_do: Can catch train, platform, time and delay in a slow, clear announcement.

skills.title: Answer questions at passport control
skills.can_do: Can answer simple questions about purpose and length of stay and where they will stay.

skills.title: Follow written directions
skills.can_do: Can follow short written directions, e.g. a friend's message on how to get to their flat, or signs inside a building.

skills.title: Ask for and understand directions
skills.can_do: Can ask where something is and follow short, simple directions to a nearby place.

skills.title: Read accommodation information
skills.can_do: Can read basic accommodation information: meal times, Wi-Fi, check-out, house rules.

skills.title: Check in at a hotel or guesthouse
skills.can_do: Can check in, give details, and ask about breakfast time, Wi-Fi and check-out.

skills.title: Send a postcard or message from a trip
skills.can_do: Can write a short postcard or message saying where they are, what it is like and what they do.

skills.title: Take a taxi
skills.can_do: Can give an address, ask the price, ask to stop, and pay.

skills.title: Buy a train or bus ticket
skills.can_do: Can buy a ticket, say where and when to, and ask about departure time and platform.

skills.title: Read timetables and departure boards
skills.can_do: Can read departure and arrival times, platforms, delays and cancellations.

skills.title: Buy food and everyday items
skills.can_do: Can say what and how much they want, ask the price, and pay, in a shop or at a market.

skills.title: Buy clothes
skills.can_do: Can ask for a size and colour, ask to try something on, and say it is too big or small.

skills.title: Read store information
skills.can_do: Can read store guides, price tags, offers and opening hours.

skills.title: Order in a cafe or restaurant
skills.can_do: Can order food and drink, ask what a dish is, handle 'we're out of that', ask for the bill and pay.

skills.title: Read a menu
skills.can_do: Can read a simple menu with its sections, dishes and prices.

skills.title: Tell a doctor what the problem is
skills.can_do: Can say what hurts, since when, and answer simple questions from a doctor.

skills.title: Ask for urgent help
skills.can_do: Can call for help, say what happened in a few words and say where they are.

skills.title: Get something at a pharmacy
skills.can_do: Can describe a simple problem, ask for something against it and understand how often to take it.

skills.title: Exchange money and ask about payment
skills.can_do: Can ask where to exchange money, ask the rate, say how much, and ask whether card or cash.

skills.title: Follow instructions in a language lesson
skills.can_do: Can follow the teacher's simple instructions: read, repeat, open the book, listen, write.

skills.title: Read a weather forecast
skills.can_do: Can read a simple forecast with temperatures and symbols.

skills.title: Talk about the weather
skills.can_do: Can say and ask what the weather is like today and tomorrow.

comm.ask-word.SI.key_structures: Question word order; 'українською' as a fixed chunk.

comm.numbers.L.key_structures: Recognition only: numbers with гривня/хвилина in all three number forms.

exponents: Вибачте, я не зрозумів / не зрозуміла.
comm.repair.SI.key_structures: Imperatives in ви-form; past tense agrees with speaker's gender (зрозумів / зрозуміла).

comm.time-dates.SI.key_structures: у + accusative for days (у суботу), у + locative for months (у травні), о + locative ordinal for clock time.

exponents: Я в магазині. Буду о п'ятій.
Пішла в аптеку, буду через годину.
Вранці я п'ю каву і їду на роботу.
У суботу я не працюю, відпочиваю.
daily.routine.SI.key_structures: Present tense incl. вставати → встаю; на + accusative for 'to work'.

exponents: Мені борщ і чай без цукру.
food.cafe.SI.key_structures: Ordered items in the accusative (каву, воду); без + genitive and з + instrumental as chunks.

exponents: Що ти любиш робити у вільний час?
Я люблю читати і грати на гітарі.
freetime.hobbies.SI.key_structures: грати на + locative (на гітарі); подобається agrees with the thing liked.

exponents: У вільний час я гуляю в парку.
(topic recognition only: sport, weather, politics, advert for a product)
Сьогодні неділя. Марко й Оля йдуть у парк.

health.doctor.SI.note: Doctor's questions quickly exceed A1; test with a slow, sympathetic interlocutor.

health.emergency.SI.note: Emergency numbers are part of the realization, not the universal skill.

exponents: Дайте, будь ласка, щось від кашлю.
Як це приймати? — Тричі на день.
Я живу в місті …, недалеко від центру.
У мене невелика квартира: дві кімнати, кухня і ванна.
home.where-live.SI.key_structures: в/у + locative; adjective agreement; 2–4 + nominative plural (дві кімнати).

personal.details.SI.key_structures: Spelling with Ukrainian letter names; possessive agreement (моє прізвище, моя адреса).

personal.form.WI.key_structures: Date format ДД.ММ.РРРР; foreign name written in Cyrillic; patronymic field may be left empty or marked '—'.
personal.form.WI.note: Patronymic (по батькові) is a Ukrainian-specific form field.

exponents: Мене звати … А вас? / А тебе?
Я з Австрії, живу у Відні.
personal.intro.SI.key_structures: Мене звати + nominative; у/в + locative for city; з + country as a chunk; ти/ви chosen consistently.

exponents: Я живу у Відні й вивчаю українську мову.
personal.intro.WI.key_structures: Accusative of adjective + noun (українську мову); у/в and і/й chosen by euphony.

exponents: Як справи? — Добре, дякую. А у вас? / А в тебе?
До побачення! / Бувай! / На все добре!
relations.courtesy.SI.key_structures: Register kept consistent within a conversation; vocative for names (Олено, пане Андрію).

exponents: У мене є брат і сестра.
У тебе є діти? — Так, син. Йому два роки.
relations.family.SI.key_structures: Animate accusative (брата, сестру) after звати; у мене є + nominative.

exponents: Це моя мама, а це мій тато.
Ліворуч — мій брат, праворуч — моя сестра.
Вона висока, у неї світле волосся.
Дуже смачно! У тебе гарна квартира.
relations.home-visit.SI.key_structures: Imperative by register (сідай / сідайте); partitive genitive in offers as a chunk (чаю, кави).

exponents: Я вже на вокзалі, біля каси.
relations.meet-point.WI.key_structures: в + locative of adjective + noun for clothes (у червоній куртці); на + locative for place.

exponents: На жаль, я не можу. — Нічого, іншим разом.
relations.plans.SI.key_structures: в/на + accusative for destination and day; о + locative ordinal for time.

exponents: Зустрінемося в суботу о третій біля театру.
Бажаю тобі щастя, здоров'я і любові!
relations.wishes.WI.key_structures: Wishes as fixed chunks; correct apostrophe in здоров'я; тобі/вам by register.

exponents: Дайте, будь ласка, хліб і кілограм яблук.
shopping.buy.SI.key_structures: Дайте + accusative; quantity + genitive plural as a chunk (кілограм яблук).

exponents: У вас є цей светр у синьому кольорі?
shopping.clothes.SI.note: Comparatives (більший) are beyond the A1 standard; accepted as chunks.

exponents: Потяг Київ — Львів відправляється з другої колії о дев'ятій двадцять.
Мета вашого візиту? — Туризм. / В гості до друзів.
Скільки днів ви будете в Україні? — Тиждень.
Де ви будете жити? — У готелі.
Іди прямо до кафе, потім ліворуч.
Це далеко? — Ні, близько, п'ять хвилин пішки.
travel.directions.SI.key_structures: до + genitive as chunk with common places (до вокзалу, до центру).

exponents: На вулицю Хрещатик, десять, будь ласка.
Один квиток до Львова, будь ласка.
О котрій відправлення? З якої платформи?
travel.ticket.SI.key_structures: на + accusative for date/time of travel; до + city as a chunk.

reading.v1.stimulus: One realistic document of the kind the skill names (menu, sign set, timetable, poster, forecast, store guide, short message or illustrated text), 40-150 words, laid out as the real thing would be.
rules: Each item has exactly one defensible answer; short answers list every accepted variant in the key.
No item can be answered from world knowledge alone.
Items cover different parts of the document; at most 2 items need arithmetic.
Questions in the instruction language; short answers may be numbers, or words copied from the text.

listening.v1.stimulus: Either 8-10 short clips (one utterance each) or one 60-120 second monologue or dialogue, written as a script and rendered with TTS. Speech rate 0.85, natural pauses between clips.
rules: Number answers are compared as digits; times accept 24h and 12h forms.
Each item depends on one clip or one clearly separated part of the script.
listening.v1.note: TTS until real recordings exist. Phonology enablers stay untested by TTS forms.

written-interaction.v1.stimulus: Optional incoming message the learner answers (20-60 words, informal or formal per realization), or a form to fill in, or a situation description in the instruction language.
rules: Content points name what to communicate, never the target-language words for it.
At least two content points require the realization's key structures.

rules.For forms: give the learner a fictional identity card in the instruction language.

written-production.v1.stimulus: Situation and audience in the instruction language.
written-production.v1.note: No A1 skill uses it; kept for A2+.

script.persona: Who the interlocutor is (e.g. waiter in a cafe in Lviv)
script.learner_goal: What the learner must achieve, in the instruction language
script.required_moves: 4-7 moves the learner must make, each tagged with enablers
script.complications: 1-2 sampled by seed from the template pool below plus skill-specific ones
script.opening_line: First interlocutor line, in the target language

complication_pool: The item asked for is not available.
The interlocutor asks a follow-up question (size, quantity, with or without something).
The interlocutor misunderstands one detail and the learner must correct it.
The interlocutor speaks a bit too fast once; the learner must ask for repetition.
roleplay.v1.channel: typed for now (heatmap only); speech later
roleplay.v1.note: The interlocutor and the grader are separate calls; the interlocutor never grades or corrects.

spoken-production.v1.stimulus: Brief with 3-5 content points; 1 minute to prepare.
spoken-production.v1.channel: speech (later); typed rehearsal allowed for practice, never for badges

rules: Every item is a short, natural sentence from an A1 situation; the target form is the only gap.
Items cover the enabler's sub-cases evenly (e.g. genitive -а and -у, hard and soft stems).

rules.Lexis checks: 12 items, meaning to word and word to meaning, from the enabler's word list.

rules: Three items drawn from the skill's full template, the most diagnostic ones.
Outcome: 3/3 likely, 2/3 shaky, 0-1/3 unknown. Probes never count toward a badge.
